title: High-NA EUV Lithography (ASML EXE)
summary: ASML's EXE platform, the commercial High-NA EUV tool for sub-2nm patterning.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Next-gen EUV with higher numerical aperture for <2nm patterning.

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

investmentLens: A single-vendor monopoly with a long order book; watch customer acceptance and throughput improvements.
